item.guhs.maanvis_spawn_egg: Tui the Moon Fish Spawn Egg
item.guhs.oceaanvis_spawn_egg: La the Ocean Fish Spawn Egg
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_schurk.praatje.vu: Kneel before Fire Lord Mikai! ...Or at least step aside. Or I'll shove you. A little.
I am the mightiest Mika so far. Every nibble in the world will be MINE. Nyeh-heh-heh.
The nibble comet is here! Feel my fire! ...It's lukewarm. But very impressively lukewarm.
From now on, call me Phoenix King. It fits my crown better, NYEG!
Hmpf. Conquering the world is so tiring. A nibble, on the other hand... nom.
*burp* ...That was not very fire-lordly. One more, then. I'm just chonky now.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_schurk.praatje.az: Almost perfect isn't perfect. And my two strands of hair are PERFECT.
I'll shove you aside. Very neatly, very precisely. Nyeh-heh-heh.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_schurk.praatje.ty: Your aura is all pink! ...Oh no wait, that's my fur.
Poke, poke, poke! Haha, kidding, I won't hurt you. Want to see me do a cartwheel?
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_schurk.praatje.zh: I am Zhao the Invincible! I say so myself, so it's true.
That moon fish, I want it in a little bag. For my collection. Grrr.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_schurk.praatje.lo: There is no nibble shortage in Ba Sing Guh. It is calm here. Here everyone is safe.
*whispers* The Dai Li see everything. Even that you just ate a nibble.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_schurk.praatje.da: Move along. Nothing to see. There is no nibble shortage in Ba Sing Guh.
We are the Dai Li. We see everything. ...Where's my hat? Oh, it's over my eyes.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_schurk.praatje.vu: Move along, guh! Or I'll shove you with my shoving stick. Gently, but still.
Long live Fire Lord Mikai! ...Is it break time yet? I could go for some fire flakes.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_schurk.praatje.ge: NOBODY has EVER escaped from The Boiling Rock! ...Let me just count my keys to be sure.
One, two, three... how many keys did I have again? Don't you run off!
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_schurk.praatje.mi: Sorry... the nibble soup is minus nibble again. Sorry.
Actually I'd like to bake little cakes for guhs. But that's not allowed here. Sorry, nyeg.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_schurk.praatje.ve: I see everything through my spyglass! ...Except what happens behind me.
Nobody gets into my fortress! And whoever does gets SHOVED back out!
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_schurk.praatje.dr: GRRRAAAH! ...Sorry, that's how dragon guhs say hello. Will you show me your fire too, little chonk?
We have been dancing for ages. Dance with us? Fire in every colour, and nobody gets burned.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_schurk.praatje.wa: I am He Who Knows Ten Thousand Things. Don't touch my books with greasy nibble paws.
You came for the knowledge, little guh? Not to get something out of it? Hoo-hoo.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_schurk.praatje.vo: *wags* We seek knowledge for the great owl! This scroll goes to shelf six.
*sniff* You smell of nibbles. That's not in any book.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_schurk.praatje.le: Talking... slowly... is... an... art... too... nyeg.
I am older than the nibble comet. And still just a guh: sweet, and very, very big.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_schurk.praatje.fl: FLOP! *licks your whole face* Flopsie happy!
*bounces up and down* Hug? Hug! HUG!
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_schurk.praatje.lu: Mrrrooo! (A sky bison guh says hello. Six legs, so six times as many cuddles.)
*snorts* Mrrooo. (He thinks you may lie on his soft back for a bit.)
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_schurk.praatje.ma: *blub* Tui swims circles around La, and La around Tui. That's how the moon stays in the sky.
*blub-nyeg* Please don't put me in a little bag.
quest.guhs.einde2_cast_schurk.praatje.oc: *blub* La is the sea and Tui is the moon. Together we swim in circles.
*blub* Swim with us? The water is nice and lukewarm.
